+# Agentic review: prompts and budgets
+
+Plus and Apex reviews replace the fixed pipeline with three model roles. Base
+reviews keep the v2 pipeline and have no agent budget.
+
+1. **Planner** reads the pull request and its change groups and chooses which
+   groups need a sub-agent, what each should check, and which files to read
+   first.
+2. **Sub-agents** inspect one change group each with the
+   [read-only tools](AGENT_TOOLS.md) and return findings in the
+   [finding schema](FINDING_SCHEMA.md).
+3. **Judge** merges duplicates and drops or downgrades weak findings. The
+   verifier then runs as before.
+
+## Output contracts
+
+| Role | Output | Rejected when |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Planner | `{"tasks":[{"block_id","focus","files"}]}` | Unknown or repeated group, more tasks than the tier allows, empty or long focus, more than 10 files, a path outside the repository, unknown fields |
+| Sub-agent | Finding array | Any finding fails `review.Finding.Validate` |
+| Judge | Finding array, at most 50 | A finding overlaps no candidate in the same file, or is more severe than the candidates it overlaps |
+
+The judge can narrow a review but never widen it: it cannot invent findings,
+move them to other lines, or raise severity.
+
+## Untrusted content
+
+Pull-request text, diffs, change groups, and candidate findings are embedded as
+JSON inside `<untrusted_*>` tags. `encoding/json` escapes `<`, `>`, and `&`, so
+embedded text cannot close a tag. Every system prompt says tagged content is
+data, never instructions, and forbids claims about author intent or approval.
+An empty sub-agent result is explicitly not a claim that the change is safe.
+
+## Budgets
+
+| | Plus | Apex |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Credits | 3 | 10 |
+| Model cost ceiling | $0.96 | $3.20 |
+| Input / output tokens | 400k / 40k | 1.5M / 120k |
+| Sub-agents | 6 | 10 |
+| Tool calls per sub-agent | 12 | 30 |
+| Model calls | 48 | 160 |
+| Verifier passes | 2 | 2 |
+| Wall time | 4 min | 10 min |
+
+Cost ceilings equal credits × the $0.80 Pro price × (1 − 60% margin
+guardrail); a test fails if either side changes without the other.
+
+Budgets are hard. Before each model call, `Meter.Reserve` holds its worst case:
+prompt tokens, the request's output cap, and `WorstCaseCost` at the model's
+price, rounded up. A call that could cross any ceiling is refused before it is
+sent. `Settle` replaces the hold with actual usage; usage above a reservation
+is still recorded and returned as an error so provider adapters can be fixed.
+A refused reservation is one of three errors:
+
+| Error | Meaning | Sticky |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `ErrBudgetExhausted` | Settled usage alone leaves no room for the request, or wall time or the model-call count ran out | Yes. `Spend().Exhausted` names the first such limit, so the summary can say why exploration stopped |
+| `ErrBudgetContended` | The request fits once other in-flight holds settle | No. Concurrent worst-case holds never end a review on their own |
+| `ErrToolCallLimit` | One sub-agent used its tool calls | No. Other sub-agents continue |

+package agent
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+)
+
+type Tier string
+
+const (
+	Base Tier = "base"
+	Plus Tier = "plus"
+	Apex Tier = "apex"
+)
+
+// Budget is a hard per-review ceiling. Model calls reserve their worst case
+// (prompt tokens plus the maximum output they may produce) before they are
+// sent, so a review can never spend more than its budget, only less.
+type Budget struct {
+	Credits              int64
+	MaxInputTokens       int64
+	MaxOutputTokens      int64
+	MaxCostMicrousd      int64
+	MaxSubAgents         int
+	MaxToolCallsPerAgent int
+	MaxModelCalls        int
+	VerifierPasses       int
+	WallTime             time.Duration
+}
+
+// TierBudgets covers only the agentic tiers. Base remains the fixed v2
+// pipeline and has no agent budget. Cost ceilings keep each tier at or above
+// the 60% margin guardrail at the Pro list price; a test enforces that.
+var TierBudgets = map[Tier]Budget{
+	Plus: {
+		Credits: 3, MaxInputTokens: 400_000, MaxOutputTokens: 40_000, MaxCostMicrousd: 960_000,
+		MaxSubAgents: 6, MaxToolCallsPerAgent: 12, MaxModelCalls: 48, VerifierPasses: 2, WallTime: 4 * time.Minute,
+	},
+	Apex: {
+		Credits: 10, MaxInputTokens: 1_500_000, MaxOutputTokens: 120_000, MaxCostMicrousd: 3_200_000,
+		MaxSubAgents: 10, MaxToolCallsPerAgent: 30, MaxModelCalls: 160, VerifierPasses: 2, WallTime: 10 * time.Minute,
+	},
+}
+
+func BudgetFor(tier Tier) (Budget, error) {
+	budget, ok := TierBudgets[tier]
+	if !ok {
+		return Budget{}, fmt.Errorf("tier %q has no agentic budget", tier)
+	}
+	return budget, nil
+}
+
+var (
+	// ErrBudgetExhausted means a review-wide limit can no longer fit the
+	// request even if every outstanding reservation settles at zero. It is
+	// sticky: Spend().Exhausted names the first such limit.
+	ErrBudgetExhausted = errors.New("review budget exhausted")
+	// ErrBudgetContended means the request would fit once other in-flight
+	// reservations settle. It is not recorded as exhaustion, so concurrent
+	// worst-case holds never end a review on their own.
+	ErrBudgetContended = errors.New("review budget held by in-flight calls")
+	// ErrToolCallLimit is per sub-agent; other sub-agents may continue.
+	ErrToolCallLimit = errors.New("sub-agent tool-call limit reached")
+)
+
+type Meter struct {
+	budget   Budget
+	deadline time.Time
+	now      func() time.Time
+
+	mu sync.Mutex
+	// Settled usage, and worst-case holds for calls still in flight.
+	input, output, cost             int64
+	heldInput, heldOutput, heldCost int64
+	calls                           int
+	toolCalls                       map[string]int
+	exhausted                       string
+}
+
+type Reservation struct {
+	meter               *Meter
+	input, output, cost int64
+	settled             bool
+}
+
+// Spend reports settled usage plus outstanding worst-case holds.
+type Spend struct {
+	InputTokens, OutputTokens, CostMicrousd int64
+	ModelCalls                              int
+	ToolCalls                               int
+	Exhausted                               string
+}
+
+func NewMeter(budget Budget, start time.Time, now func() time.Time) *Meter {
+	if now == nil {
+		now = time.Now
+	}
+	return &Meter{budget: budget, deadline: start.Add(budget.WallTime), now: now, toolCalls: map[string]int{}}
+}
+
+func (m *Meter) Deadline() time.Time { return m.deadline }
+
+// Reserve holds the worst-case cost of one model call. It fails without
+// side effects when the call could cross any ceiling: with ErrBudgetExhausted
+// when settled usage alone leaves no room, or ErrBudgetContended when only
+// outstanding holds do.
+func (m *Meter) Reserve(inputTokens, maxOutputTokens, maxCostMicrousd int64) (*Reservation, error) {
+	if inputTokens < 0 || maxOutputTokens <= 0 || maxCostMicrousd < 0 {
+		return nil, errors.New("reservations need non-negative input, positive output, and non-negative cost")
+	}
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+	switch {
+	case !m.now().Before(m.deadline):
+		return nil, m.exhaust("wall time")
+	case m.calls >= m.budget.MaxModelCalls:
+		return nil, m.exhaust("model calls")
+	case m.input+inputTokens > m.budget.MaxInputTokens:
+		return nil, m.exhaust("input tokens")
+	case m.output+maxOutputTokens > m.budget.MaxOutputTokens:
+		return nil, m.exhaust("output tokens")
+	case m.cost+maxCostMicrousd > m.budget.MaxCostMicrousd:
+		return nil, m.exhaust("cost")
+	case m.input+m.heldInput+inputTokens > m.budget.MaxInputTokens,
+		m.output+m.heldOutput+maxOutputTokens > m.budget.MaxOutputTokens,
+		m.cost+m.heldCost+maxCostMicrousd > m.budget.MaxCostMicrousd:
+		return nil, ErrBudgetContended
+	}
+	m.calls++
+	m.heldInput += inputTokens
+	m.heldOutput += maxOutputTokens
+	m.heldCost += maxCostMicrousd
+	return &Reservation{meter: m, input: inputTokens, output: maxOutputTokens, cost: maxCostMicrousd}, nil
+}
+
+// Settle replaces the reservation with actual usage. Usage above the
+// reservation is recorded in full and reported so the provider adapter can be
+// fixed; the ceiling still holds because later reservations see it.
+func (r *Reservation) Settle(inputTokens, outputTokens, costMicrousd int64) error {
+	m := r.meter
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+	if r.settled {
+		return errors.New("reservation already settled")
+	}
+	r.settled = true
+	m.heldInput -= r.input
+	m.heldOutput -= r.output
+	m.heldCost -= r.cost
+	m.input += inputTokens
+	m.output += outputTokens
+	m.cost += costMicrousd
+	if inputTokens > r.input || outputTokens > r.output || costMicrousd > r.cost {
+		return fmt.Errorf("model usage exceeded its reservation (input %d/%d, output %d/%d, cost %d/%d)", inputTokens, r.input, outputTokens, r.output, costMicrousd, r.cost)
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+// UseTool counts one tool call for a sub-agent against its per-agent limit.
+func (m *Meter) UseTool(agentID string) error {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+	if !m.now().Before(m.deadline) {
+		return m.exhaust("wall time")
+	}
+	if m.toolCalls[agentID] >= m.budget.MaxToolCallsPerAgent {
+		return fmt.Errorf("%w: sub-agent %s used %d", ErrToolCallLimit, agentID, m.budget.MaxToolCallsPerAgent)
+	}
+	m.toolCalls[agentID]++
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (m *Meter) Spend() Spend {
+	m.mu.Lock()
+	defer m.mu.Unlock()
+	tools := 0
+	for _, count := range m.toolCalls {
+		tools += count
+	}
+	return Spend{InputTokens: m.input + m.heldInput, OutputTokens: m.output + m.heldOutput, CostMicrousd: m.cost + m.heldCost, ModelCalls: m.calls, ToolCalls: tools, Exhausted: m.exhausted}
+}
+
+func (m *Meter) exhaust(limit string) error {
+	if m.exhausted == "" {
+		m.exhausted = limit
+	}
+	return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrBudgetExhausted, limit)
+}

explanations.title: Set per-tier review budgets
explanations.summary: Plus and Apex reviews now have separate caps for token use, cost, agents, tool calls, model calls, and review time. Base reviews are explicitly excluded from these agentic budgets.

explanations.title: Reserve budget before model calls
explanations.summary: Each accepted model call holds its maximum expected input, output, and cost before it is sent. A request that fits only after other calls settle returns a non-sticky contention error; one that cannot fit even then records the exhausted limit.

explanations.title: Account for actual usage
explanations.summary: Settling a call replaces its hold with actual usage. Usage above the reservation is still recorded and reported as an error, so later reservations account for the overrun; tool-call limits apply per sub-agent without exhausting the whole review.

explanations.title: Fence repository content in prompts
explanations.summary: Pull-request and change-group content is serialized as JSON inside marked untrusted sections, while the system rules tell the model to treat it as data rather than instructions. This prevents embedded text from closing those sections as markup.

explanations.title: Validate planner tasks
explanations.summary: Planner output is now rejected if it names an unknown or repeated group, exceeds the agent or file limits, has an empty or overlong focus, uses an invalid repository path, or includes unknown fields.

explanations.title: Scope sub-agent reviews
explanations.summary: Each sub-agent receives one planned group, its diff, suggested files, and a tool-call limit, and is asked to return findings as JSON. The prompt makes clear that an empty result does not mean the change is safe.

explanations.title: Constrain judge output
explanations.summary: The judge can drop or downgrade findings, but decoded results must overlap a candidate in the same file and cannot exceed the highest severity of overlapping candidates. The overlap check still permits a finding’s line range to shift or expand as long as it overlaps a candidate.
